overview: You read the Theatre's bill at home. The Shrew was at two. You were not in it, and you did not go. There was no author's name on the paper.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the bill and did not leave the house.

assets.name: the Shrew
assets.disposition: Read the Shrew bill at the lodging

important_dates.meaning: The Shrew, and he is not in it
